MEMB-VBEAM.description: PSC Virtual Beam Member (PSCMEMB). Fields are driven by the list of Virtual Beam elements grouped as one design member and its joint type.

AELEM.description: Element Lists. List of Virtual Beam element IDs that make up this member; each ID must reference an existing Virtual Beam. Requires at least 1 element when ELEM_MEMBER is true, otherwise at least 2 elements.

ELEM_MEMBER.description: Allow Single Element Member. When true, AELEM may contain a single element; when false, AELEM must contain at least 2 elements. Not stored in the database; used only for AELEM size validation on set and excluded from GET responses.
